name: Junk

source.title: Pathfinder rules text (Foundry PF2E trait descriptions)

text: Spells with the junk trait use scrap, trash, and other debris found in any environment. While casting a junk spell requires no locus, it assumes the spellcaster always has access to discarded scraps or naturally occurring detritus. If the caster has absolutely nothing on their person or in their environment, they might be unable to cast a junk spell.
